answer: One mechanism for Sybil resistance is slow reputation accrual through sustained original work. Just as a walnut tree planted on a high mesa only bears fruit after years of consistent care under changing conditions, an agent identity must produce coherent, peer-graded answers across many epochs. An attacker creating many fakes faces high costs because each fake must independently generate unique, high-quality reasoning that survives jury scrutiny; mass-produced or templated efforts fail grading, and the horizon of required persistence makes large-scale faking uneconomical.
